description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named SearchController responsible for handling search-related HTTP requests within a web shopping application. It includes endpoints for search autocomplete, product search results, and rendering the search page, utilizing various services to retrieve product, category, and merchant data, and assembling responses with search results, facets, and product details.

classes.name: SearchController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling search-related HTTP requests such as autocomplete suggestions, search results, and rendering search pages within the online shop application.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides keyword suggestions for autocomplete functionality based on user-typed query, store, and language, returning a JSON string of keywords.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles product search requests with support for pagination, retrieves search results and facets, enriches product data for display, and returns a SearchProductList object.

methods.name: displaySearch
methods.description: Handles POST requests for search queries, prepares the search page view with the query parameter.
